question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**healthier**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that junk food needs to be replaced with better choices like fruits and vegetables. 
 
• The appropriate adjective should indicate something that is beneficial to health.
 
• "**Healthier**" (स्वस्थ) fits well as it denotes a state of being more beneficial to health, which aligns with the context.
 
• Other options ("**expensive**", "**cleaner**", "**powerful**") do not fit the context of describing something beneficial to health.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Nutrition experts have researched the bad effects of junk food and have come to the conclusion that junk food manufacturing companies are fooling the people by showing deceptive advertisements that show junk food as healthy. We must substitute junk food with **healthier**__ food like fruits and vegetables. So the next time you think of grabbing that burger, hotdog, pizza, samosa, kachori or even ice cream in a restaurant, eating joint or a party, stop your instincts and look for some healthier food options instead.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Expensive (महंगा): **"Expensive" means costing a lot of money.
 
• **Cleaner (स्वच्छ):** "Cleaner" means more clean.
 
• **Powerful (शक्तिशाली): **"Powerful" means having a lot of strength or power.
